entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Haitian Revolution, a transformative movement in Venezuela (1795–1810). Emerged from Chirino's revolt — first slave uprising tied to Haitian Revolution and Spanish Bourbon. Catalyzed Francisco de Miranda's failed liberation expeditions and Venezuela declares independence — July 5, 1811.
